questions.text: After Rajendra Chola returned from his voyage to Indonesia, he ________ to visit the temple in Thanjavur.
questions.solution:
The sentence describes completed actions in the past ("returned"), so the matching simple past is "wished".

Answer: wished

questions.text: Research in the workplace reveals that people work for many reasons _______________ .
questions.solution:
"Besides" means "in addition to": people work for many reasons besides money. "Beside" means "next to".

Answer: besides money

questions.text: Rahul, Murali, Srinivas and Arul are seated around a square table. Rahul is sitting to the left of Murali. Srinivas is sitting to the right of Arul. Which of the following pairs are seated opposite each other?
questions.solution:
Seat everyone facing the centre. Put Murali at one side; Rahul on Murali's left takes the next seat. Of the two remaining seats, Srinivas must be on Arul's right, which works only with Srinivas directly opposite Murali (and Arul opposite Rahul).

Answer: Srinivas and Murali

questions.text: Find the smallest number [latex]y[/latex] such that [latex]y  \times 162[/latex] is a perfect cube.
questions.solution:
[latex]162=2\times3^4[/latex]. For a cube every exponent must be a multiple of 3: we need [latex]2^2\times3^2=36[/latex].
[latex]36\times162=5832=18^3[/latex]

Answer: 36

questions.text: The probability that a k-digit number does NOT contain the digits 0, 5, or 9 is
questions.solution:
Each digit avoids 3 of the 10 digits, so it has a 7/10 chance. For k independent digits: [latex]0.7^k[/latex].

Answer: [latex]0.7^k[/latex]
